# discord_current_application (Data Source)

The application (app) the bot token belongs to, e.g. for arguments that need an application ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_current_application" "app" {}

output "application_id" {
  value = data.discord_current_application.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `approximate_server_count` (Number) Approximate number of servers the application has been added to.
- `bot_id` (String) ID of the application's bot user.
- `bot_public` (Boolean) Whether anyone, not only the owner, can add the bot to servers.
- `bot_require_code_grant` (Boolean) Whether the bot joins servers only after the full OAuth2 code grant flow.
- `description` (String) Application description.
- `flags` (Number) Public application flags as a bitfield.
- `icon_hash` (String) Hash of the application icon.
- `id` (String) Application ID.
- `interactions_endpoint_url` (String) URL that receives interactions, if set.
- `name` (String) Application name.
- `owner_id` (String) ID of the application owner. For applications owned by a team, this is the team's placeholder user.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server associated with the application, such as a support server.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags describing the application.
- `verify_key` (String) Hex-encoded public key for verifying interaction requests.
